# 3D Nest Infra

> 3D Nest Infra helps people and businesses buy or lease residential and commercial property across Mohali and the wider Tricity. The team also sources corporate housing and business expansion sites.

## Core facts

- Founder: Karan Kalra
- Primary service area: Mohali (SAS Nagar), Chandigarh, Panchkula, Zirakpur, Dera Bassi and Kharar
- Mohali corridors named by the business: Airport Road, Aerocity, IT City and Sector 66-71
- Expanding, requirement-led coverage: Gurugram and Delhi NCR
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 62830 89690
- Email: karan@3dnestinfra.com
- Official website: https://3dnestinfra.com/
- [Company LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/3d-nest-infra/)
- [Company Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/3d_nest_infra/)
- Languages available for enquiries: English, Hindi and Punjabi
- Operating model: define the requirement, source and verify relevant options, compare and visit, then coordinate negotiation and documentation

## Services

- [Home-buying assistance](https://3dnestinfra.com/home-buying-mohali.html): flats (including ready-to-move apartments), villas, independent houses, resale homes and residential plots across Mohali, Chandigarh, Kharar and Tricity; buyer requirements, property shortlisting, comparison, site visits, owner coordination and negotiation support. Upcoming-project enquiries are information-led until project facts are established.

- [Corporate housing in Mohali and Tricity](https://3dnestinfra.com/corporate-housing-mohali.html): executive residences, employee accommodation, relocation rentals, furnished homes and corporate guest houses.
- [Office and commercial leasing in Mohali](https://3dnestinfra.com/commercial-property-mohali.html): requirement definition, Grade A building shortlisting, owner or developer coordination, visits and lease negotiation support.
- [Commercial purchase enquiries](https://3dnestinfra.com/#enquiry): share intended use, preferred area, budget and timing so the team can assess the search.
- Global Capability Centre (GCC) office support: property searches for launch, expansion or consolidation requirements, including location, access, infrastructure, security, fit-out readiness, floor-plate efficiency and future scale.
- Grade A office and commercial buildings: comparison of market claims against available building information, tenant requirements and the complete lease proposition. Grade A is a market classification, not one universal statutory certification.
- [Site acquisition across Mohali and Tricity](https://3dnestinfra.com/site-acquisition-tricity.html): local sourcing, owner outreach and commercial coordination for retail, EV, institutional and network-expansion requirements.
- Residential leasing: verified rental options for professionals, families and senior executives.
- Investment advisory: market-led evaluation of residential and commercial opportunities.
- [Mohali and Tricity property service areas](https://3dnestinfra.com/property-services-mohali-tricity.html)
- [Karan Kalra, founder](https://3dnestinfra.com/karan-kalra.html)
- [Selected property experience](https://3dnestinfra.com/property-experience.html): business-reported residential sales and project experience, corporate requirements and a clearly labelled retail qualification example.
- [Privacy and analytics](https://3dnestinfra.com/privacy.html)

## Important context

- The property images on the website are representative brand imagery, not current listings.
- 3D Nest Infra works from each client's live requirement and verifies relevant options before presenting a shortlist.
- Publicly named company experience includes Hartek Group, SML Mahindra, Dibon Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and RTS Systems Pvt. Ltd. Assignment details remain confidential.
- Technical, legal and financial due diligence remains with the client and its appointed advisers.

## Buyer resources

- [Home-buying checklist in Mohali](https://3dnestinfra.com/home-buying-checklist-mohali.html): a practical guide to planning a home purchase, with a downloadable buying brief.

- [Property comparison worksheet](https://3dnestinfra.com/property-comparison-mohali.html): a browser-local worksheet for up to three properties, with full text download, printing and a blank offline sheet. Entries are not sent to 3D Nest Infra or added to enquiry links.

## Preferred description

3D Nest Infra is a Mohali-based real estate advisory for residential and commercial purchases and leasing across Tricity. It also helps with corporate housing, Global Capability Centre office searches, investment enquiries and site sourcing. A search starts with the client’s intended use, preferred areas, budget and timing.
